title: bugs team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/bugs.yaml, the team layer of the bugs plugin's settings, read by /bugs:scan for its rotation lanes and filing posture and written by /bugs:setup apply. Keys, layers and merge semantics: plugins/bugs/reference/config.md. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

lanes.description: The rotation set /bugs:scan walks on a bare invocation, in declaration order. Entries concatenate across layers, deduplicated by name; an explicit empty list drops every inherited lane and the bundled defaults.

name.description: Kebab-case lane identity: what --lane <name> selects, what the cursor records and what the merge deduplicates on.

globs.description: Globs relative to the repository root, include-only. Single-quote a glob that starts with *.

filing_posture.description: Deprecated: set filing_posture in docs/conventions/work-items.yaml instead (plugins/work-items/schemas/work-items.schema.json). /bugs:scan reads this key for one more release, with a notice, only when the work-items file does not set it. manual-only files nothing; allowed permits --track to file.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example scan); an entry beats this file's verification value.
